I attached our current AMI walkthrough and the draft Private Offer terms they commented on last week.

If you can’t make these, please send availability and any key talking points.

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa — thanks for the heads up. Wed 10am PST works for me. Quick notes after skimming the attachments:

- Product page: we should surface a single primary benefit line about predictable LLM inference cost and one bullet about dedicated and private deployment options. Avoid deep technical kernel claims on the product tile (legal flagged similar in past).
- Trial entitlements: propose a 14-day Private Offer with throttled vCPU/GPU hours (we can map SKU limits). That keeps costs bounded for both sides and is familiar to AWS procurement.
- Co-sell: I’ll propose Jonas as the sales-engineering liaison for field enablement; he can run a short one-pager for field sellers.

If Kim can confirm legal ok on the two small copy swaps below, I’ll draft the product page copy before the workshop:
1) Hero sentence suggestion: "Predictable LLM inference — hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
2) Bullet (benefit): "Reduce per-token cost up to 5x with automatic batching and prefix caching."

Happy to own the product copy draft.

-Ben

Thanks for the timing — Kim here. High-level legal guidance before the workshop:

- Phrase "up to 5x" as a product performance estimate only if we can substantiate with our benchmarks and include a short parenthetical: (typical ranges depend on model & input length). Otherwise use conservative language: "significant per-token savings with batching and caching."
- Private Offer trial: legal is fine with a 14-day trial, but we should include explicit SKU caps and rate limits in the Private Offer terms and list the exact AMI/AMI version. Don’t promise SLA changes for trial tiers.
- For co-sell materials: Jonas to create the seller one-pager. Jonas — please include recommended discovery questions and one field-facing demo script (2 minutes).

I added Jonas to align on enablement ownership.

-Kim
